title: Tame Hecke Eigensheaves with Several Marked Points
main_claim: For SL_n in characteristic p>n, a curve of genus at least 2 and s>=2 marked points: every Zariski-dense tame PGL_n-parameter with unipotent boundary monodromy (any Jordan type, including zero) has a nonzero locally constructible perverse Hecke eigensheaf on Bun_{SL_n,B,D}. The sheaf has nilpotent singular support and a fully coherent (tensor/fusion) eigenstructure.

issues.location: Sec 8, Lemma con:unramified and the Sec 7 inputs (desc:exchange, unit, trace)
issues.description: Several key steps are imported from the companion paper [CT] (Lemmas 7.2-7.4, 8.1, Prop 5.1) and from Dhillon-Taylor, Gaitsgory-Raskin, AGKRRV and Nadler-Yun, and are not proved here. The several-point extensions are argued carefully, but the result depends on these black boxes.
issues.evidence: con:unramified is stated as [CT, Lemma 8.1]. desc:exchange's proof is 'This is [CT, Lemma 7.3]'. The local trace (desc:local-trace) is quoted from DT Props 5.3.1 and 9.3.1.

coverage: Read the introduction, construction, descent, perverse and lifting sections in full, plus the geometry and foundations statements and the detection theorem statements. Checks: (1) the twisted-node root-series calculation. Positive roots give u^j a(u^m) -> a(t) and negative roots give u^{m-j} b -> t b(t), so the group is I_B. The opposite generator on the second branch gives B^-. The centralizer is T because 0<<alpha,lambda><m. (2) The quotient [(A1+ x A2+)/T^s] with one independent gluing per node. (3) Orientation reversal gives inverse boundary monodromy, consistent with the zeta action (u,v)->(zeta u, zeta^{-1} v). Also checked tower gluing, lifting by proper henselian invariance, and connectedness of the generic torsor via flatness of the coarse space and semicontinuity, which gives image all of H. (4) Nonvanishing via the Dedekind triviality of SL_n bundles off a point plus a proper Hecke extension. (5) Descent: a Borel-valued nilpotent residue has zero toral part, so Q is T^s-monodromic. chi_V(a_i)=dim V for all V forces a_i=1, since W-invariants separate semisimple classes. The top-degree H_c^{2r} term survives the spectral sequence when monodromy is unipotent. (6) Equivariance of the adjugate frame uses det rho_V=1, valid because PGL_n has no characters. Truncation commutes with central endomorphisms. (7) Isotropy proof with rational flags. (8) The W(k) lift: inertia has l-power order, so root indices are prime to p. K0 is isomorphic to C by a cardinality argument. Not checked: the transverse-modification/detection internals (Sec 4-5 details) or the cited CT/DT/GR/AGKRRV/NY results.
sibling_notes: This is consistent with sibling rank247 (the constructible tame eigensheaves paper, one marked point), which checked the same alcove node calculation and torus descent. This paper extends them to s nodes with an orientation-reversed second component; I found no new gap in that extension.
